shortDescription: Dispatch a legacy add-on admin action
description: Run an administrative route owned by an installed add-on that has no action declarations.
Verifies administrator credentials and issues a new authenticated session and its cookies. Login admission and rate limits apply.
Revokes the current session when present and clears its cookies. The call also accepts an absent or invalid session.
Returns the authenticated account's safe profile and its current session metadata.
Returns a cursor page of the caller's active sessions for the current account version.
Revokes the specified session owned by the authenticated account. Revoking the current session clears its cookies.
Returns a cursor page of safe account profiles, with the supported status filter.
Creates an installation-wide administrator account with a validated email and password.
Replaces the password under an account-version check and invalidates that account's sessions.
Changes the account's blocked state under a version check, with session invalidation and last-administrator protections.
Soft-deletes the selected administrator under a version check and invalidates the account's sessions. Protects the last active administrator.
Returns the installation's administration address and its current settings version.
Verifies the candidate address, updates the installation settings under a version check and invalidates cookies bound to the previous settings version.
Returns the active installation resource allocation and available process and database resource controls.
Applies supported installation controls for site-serving processes, database pool sizing and managed database CPU. Uses the resource runtime's guarded update.
Upgrades the connection to a read-only WebSocket subscription for installation CPU telemetry. The subscription rechecks administrator authority.
Reports whether site and full-installation calibration can run on this installation.
Returns the available calibration run summaries. An optional site filter selects a subset of the installation's runs.
Returns the selected run's state, progress and recorded results or recommendation when available.
Starts a supervised measurement run from the selected versioned calibration profile.
Requests cancellation of the selected run and lets the supervisor finish its cleanup and restoration work.
Applies an eligible completed run's recommendation to the installation resource settings under a version check.
Returns a bounded cursor page of profiles, optionally filtered by site.
Saves a new validated site or installation calibration profile with its targets and workload settings.
Returns the identified calibration profile and its current edit version.
Replaces the editable settings of a calibration profile under an expected-version check.
Removes the selected calibration profile under an expected-version check.
Validates an uploaded runtime archive against the currently selected package and records an immutable update candidate for review.
Returns the identifiable update candidate or recorded outcome, including the package versions, mode and state.
Applies or reconciles the prepared runtime update installation-wide. Existing site connections, configuration and business data are retained.
Lists installation-wide package installation results. The route includes an authorized site context.
Installs a verified prebuilt runtime from the supported stable repository release. Installation registers the package for the entire CMS installation. The route includes an authorized site context.
Returns the installation's site catalog for administrative site discovery.
Creates a site with the supplied identity and language settings, and provisions its initial CMS-owned site content and routes.
Returns the selected site's administrative state, including configuration and language settings.
Returns the site's time zone, serving addresses and transliteration tables.
Updates the site time zone, serving addresses or one transliteration table using captured settings for concurrency control.
Returns the site's editable page summaries, including parent identities and positions for the administration tree.
Creates a draft page on the site. Without permission to materialize a URL, assigns an address from the H1 and the actual parent page.
Returns the identified site's editable page state, including source content and its draft rendering settings.
Updates supported fields of the existing page, such as title, Markdown, metadata and request caching policy.
Changes an existing page's parent or order in the site page tree under the operation's placement checks.
Returns the publication options and available templates for the site.
Returns the identified page's publication options, including template selection and relevant working path information.
Publishes the saved page and activates a release. Supplying a manual path requires the URL materialization action. Can execute rendering code.
Builds and activates a full-site release from retained published page versions. The build can execute rendering code.
Renders the saved draft through the page composition and returns the Markdown preview without activating a release. Rendering can execute snippets.
Returns the Markdown for the page in the active release. Uses the saved representation for static content or executes the frozen request rendering plan for a dynamic page.
Renders the saved draft to inspect its assembled JSON-LD graph and warnings. Rendering can execute snippets.
Extracts JSON-LD from the active publication's page output. A dynamic page requires executing the frozen request rendering plan.
Returns the site's available template-variable definitions and the catalog version.
Replaces the versioned site catalog, allowing field definitions to be added, changed or removed in one save.
Returns the page's template-variable values, their available definitions and the versions needed for a guarded edit.
Saves the draft page's template-variable values using its captured page, template, catalog and media state.
Returns the site's versioned JSON-LD profile catalog and the data needed to edit it.
Replaces the versioned JSON-LD catalog, allowing profiles and reusable objects to be added, changed or removed.
Returns the working URL catalog, page summaries and active publication or sitemap information used by the URL workspace.
Returns bounded path matches suitable for the requested parent or redirect selection.
Returns the ordered history of the selected URL on the site.

shortDescription: Move or reorganize a page URL
description: Moves or reparents a page route. Options can create replacement routes, retain or remove old routes and promote or retarget related URLs. Applies the saved routing to the active publication when applicable.
Changes the selected redirect's target or status under the expected version. When an active release exists, applies the change through a new routing-only release.
Creates a working page route or redirect at a virtual path. A page route can reorganize the page tree. A redirect can activate a routing-only release.
Builds and activates a routing-only release using saved routes and frozen public content.
Returns the requested site's bounded aggregate diagnostics for page resolution and delivery.
Returns available add-on definitions and site connection summaries, including retained connections.
Returns the add-on definition and the selected site's connection state and configuration.
Creates a new enabled connection or re-enables the retained connection with validated configuration and guarded connection state.
Updates the selected site's add-on configuration under a connection-version check.
Disables the site's connection under a version check while retaining its configuration and business records.

shortDescription: Check for a repository add-on update
description: Checks the latest stable release from the saved GitHub repository and prepares a verified update for explicit installation.
Returns the connected add-on screens and Action IDs available to the authenticated site actor.

shortDescription: Read an accessible add-on workspace asset
description: Streams a browser asset for a connected add-on workspace after checking its bound Actions.
Returns the runtime digest and registered browser entry and styles for the selected site and add-on, when a runtime view exists.
Streams a declared JavaScript or CSS asset from the selected immutable add-on runtime for the authorized site.
Returns the selected site's deployment target, current public release and the latest delivery state and version.
Creates or updates the site's deployment target using its captured configuration version. The command can enable or disable delivery and change its configured destination.
Runs bounded diagnostics for the saved target, active release and backend, and returns the results without queuing delivery.
Queues another delivery of the current site release after a known failure, using the captured delivery version.
Returns the site's versioned file and folder catalog used by administration and media pickers.
Streams a new file into the site's media library using its captured version. For images the requested mode can include responsive variants.
Creates a folder under the selected media root or same-site folder, using the captured library version.
Returns the CMS references to the selected file after checking the submitted library version.
Streams the selected original or named variant for an authorized site file.
Streams replacement image bytes and rebuilds applicable variants while retaining the library identity and public output names.

shortDescription: Move or rename a media file
description: Changes the file's name or folder under a file guard. The explicit reference-update option can update affected content and active published references, with a separate retry after the file moves.
Removes the file and its variants under the media-library contract. The explicit force option skips the normal reference review.
Runs reconciliation for the site's pending media operations, rebuilding the required projection and finishing safe cleanup.
Returns the selected site's configured favicon metadata, or a null favicon.

shortDescription: Upload or replace the site favicon
description: Streams and validates the site favicon, creating or replacing its current file and applying the published favicon change.
Removes the site's configured favicon and applies the removal to public delivery.
Creates a private archive of CMS installation data and site storage for every site.
Replaces CMS installation data and site storage from a compatible installation snapshot. Existing administrator sessions are revoked.
Downloads a previously created installation archive as a private gzip stream.
Lists saved site archives with their metadata, including archive type, creation time and size.
Returns options for a Site, Snippets, Chunks, Templates, Addons or Files export, including selectable objects when the type supports them.
Captures a complete or selected partial archive for the site, with the configured content or add-on parts for the chosen archive type.
Streams a gzip archive into the site's private dump storage and validates it before registering the upload. Restoration is a separate action.
Streams the selected private archive as a gzip attachment. Full archives can contain private content and business data.
Validates the saved archive and returns its type, selectable items, eligible replacement targets, source dependencies and an opaque review version.

shortDescription: Restore or apply a site archive
description: Replaces the selected site's owned state from a complete archive or applies explicitly selected partial items and mappings. Full restore can replace or remove existing owned objects.
Removes the selected site-owned archive. The operation also succeeds if that archive is already absent.
Returns the site's hook definitions, source and subscription summaries, and organization tree.
Returns the site handler's draft, its applied state and current version.
Creates a new disabled site handler draft with the submitted title, kind and source.
Updates the title and draft source under the handler version check while retaining the currently applied version.
Validates and compiles the captured handler draft, creates an immutable applied version and updates the active version reference.

shortDescription: Enable or disable a hook handler
description: Changes the handler's enabled state under the expected version. Enabling requires a valid applied implementation.
Creates or updates a guarded site binding with its event, handler, filtering and delivery configuration.
Applies the explicit identity and version order for the complete set of bindings on the selected site hook.
Returns the site's bounded delivery history for inspecting attempts and their outcomes.
Requests another execution of a retryable site delivery using its expected version and retained execution identity.
Records the operator's reason and advances an eligible held delivery under its expected version.
Returns the site's templates catalog with the descriptors used by administration.
Creates a named rendering source with its supported HTML, CSS, browser TypeScript and typed parameters.
Returns the site's template by stable key, including the editable content and its current version.
Replaces the element's editable markup, styles, browser TypeScript and parameters under an expected-version check.

Builds and stores a temporary preview of the saved template in the context of a page that uses it, checking the element version before and after rendering. The render can execute snippets and returns an owner-bound preview URL.
Returns the site's chunks catalog with the descriptors used by administration.
Creates a named rendering source with its supported HTML, CSS, browser TypeScript and typed parameters.
Returns the site's chunk by stable key, including the editable content and its current version.
Replaces the element's editable markup, styles, browser TypeScript and parameters under an expected-version check.

Builds and stores a temporary preview of the saved chunk in the context of a page that uses it, checking the element version before and after rendering. The render can execute snippets and returns an owner-bound preview URL.
Returns the site's snippets catalog with the descriptors used by administration.
Creates a named typed snippet with its source, parameters, return contract and execution settings.
Returns the site's snippet by stable key, including the editable content and its current version.
Replaces the snippet's editable source and contract under an expected-version check.

Builds and stores a temporary preview of the saved snippet in the context of a page that uses it, checking the element version before and after rendering. The render can execute snippets and returns an owner-bound preview URL.
Returns the generated HTML for an owner-bound preview after rechecking the actor's session and access to the preview's captured site.
Returns an empty success response when the configured HTTP service can answer the readiness probe.
Returns the readiness status without a response body.
Returns observed resource limits over the private resource-helper socket.
Applies the authorized resource allocation through the private resource-helper socket.
Runs the private helper's bounded calibration workload and returns the measured results.
Uses the active site's generated sitemap artifact.

shortDescription: Read metadata for the published sitemap
description: Uses the active site's generated sitemap artifact. Sends the status and headers without a response body.
Serves an eligible public asset from the active release for the resolved site.

shortDescription: Read metadata for an active release asset
description: Serves an eligible public asset from the active release for the resolved site. Sends the status and headers without a response body.
Serves an eligible public asset from the requested site-owned release.

shortDescription: Read metadata for a versioned release asset
description: Serves an eligible public asset from the requested site-owned release. Sends the status and headers without a response body.
Serves the site's configured public favicon when media delivery is enabled.

shortDescription: Read metadata for the public favicon
description: Serves the site's configured public favicon when media delivery is enabled. Sends the status and headers without a response body.
Serves an eligible image or derivative under the configured public media prefix for the resolved site.

shortDescription: Read metadata for a public image

shortDescription: Read metadata for a public file

Resolves the site's active document route, including its root and crawler documents. Redirects when registered, serves stored output or runs the frozen rendering plan for a dynamic route.

shortDescription: Read metadata for a published document
description: Resolves the site's active document route, including its root and crawler documents. Redirects when registered, serves stored output or runs the frozen rendering plan for a dynamic route. Sends the status and headers without a response body.
Serves a generated document or public preview asset by its temporary identity on the CLI preview's separate loopback listener.

Replaces Manager grants, manages a custom role and its site assignments, or manages a site access group and its memberships using the captured policy revision.
